page.overview:
Who is Antonio Veloce Eccellente?

Antonio Veloce Eccellente is a minor character in Cars.

Antonio owns the most celebrated gas station in Italy. Located in Maranello, it has been in the family for many generations and is loved by locals and celebrities alike. Cars come to the station to see who's going to be there, and his grandmother's special balsamic fuel is why they stay.
